name: everything
description: All of Biswajeet's agent skills (reviewloop + standup). reviewloop drives a PR to all-clear across every reviewer; standup generates a paste-ready daily update from your GitHub activity.

interface.shortDescription: PR review automation + daily standups for coding agents
interface.longDescription: reviewloop drives a pull request to a fully-clear state across every reviewer (Greptile, CodeRabbit, Copilot, humans), re-triggering bots and looping until nothing actionable remains. standup generates a paste-ready daily update from your merged, opened, and reviewed PRs across the org.
